player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Texan''') posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
description: Steal everything and laugh everytime it comes across in your deck.  Now that is tech.  Want more tech?  Beat some one down with their own ties, or use them as fofeit fodder.  TECH BABY

notes: Posted 8 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation, Cloud City: Casino, Bespin, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Your Insight Serves You Well, Keeping The Empire Out Forever and Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Quite Mining Colony / Independent Operations' dested Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation; 'Do or Do Not & Wise Advice' the combo Do, Or Do Not & •Wise Advice (an Effect in 2001).

Posted 'Obi-Wan with Light saber' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Luke with Light saber' Luke With Lightsaber; 'Qui-Gon' the Tatooine Qui-Gon Jinn; 'Lando Calrission' the Cloud City Lando Calrissian.
Posted 'Fall Back' dested Fall Back!; 'Into the Ventilations Shaft, Lefty' Into The Ventilation Shaft, Lefty.

Two lines after the Effects ('If you are seeing pod racing replace Chasm Walkway with Ani's racer.' and 'Also I usually play this deck with grimtassh but cannot figure out what to take out.') are comments, not cards, and have been dropped.
The byline is Stephen "Texan" Beckham, but the strategy is signed 'Ryan'; credited to the byline.
The strategy says the deck is undefeated in tournament play only because the two tournaments it was entered in did not run; no event is named.
